_daytona_only: Daytona is the ONLY sandbox provider TrueForge supports today (docs/sandbox.mdx). The schema is strict and takes only an api_key, with no endpoint field.
_endpoint: The endpoint is NOT set here. TrueForge builds the SDK client without an apiUrl, so the Daytona SDK falls back to DAYTONA_API_URL in the TrueForge process environment. Unset => Daytona Cloud. Set => a self-hosted server. Verified by interception. See intro.md 9.1.
_key_permissions: The API key MUST have Snapshots write/create (and delete) permission, not just Sandboxes. On first configure TrueForge builds a release snapshot in your Daytona account and clones every sandbox from it. A key without snapshot permission fails at configure time even though it is otherwise valid.
_optional: Skip this file entirely when running TrueForge with STANDALONE=true — the built-in local sandbox needs no provider row. See intro.md §3.
_all_fields_required: The schema is .strict(); every field below must be present.
